distancePolicy: Use 177-195 km in overview until section geometry is reconciled.

Official total distance varies by source: newer Västsverige pages say roughly 177-195 km depending on route variations; Skaraborgsleder's older overview says 195 km in HTML but 189 km in the 2009 overview PDF; stage totals differ depending on whether stage 1 is counted as 30, 31, or 36 km and stage 8 as 29 or 31 km.

sourcePolicy: Use current official/Naturkartan/Google KML evidence as primary per section where section files identify it.
Use OSM/E1 as cross-check only where the risk/readiness files say so.
Do not integrate runtime route geometry from this handoff; keep candidate normalization work inside this trail folder until explicitly requested.

sectionActions.action: Implement documented stage-1 primary/alternate variant model during geometry normalization.
sectionActions.caveat: Ready for candidate normalization; do not use incomplete full-stage Naturkartan GPX as runtime geometry.

sectionActions.action: Implement direct primary plus Skackastugan alternate during geometry normalization.
sectionActions.caveat: Preserve measured direct and alternate lengths as geometry metadata.

sectionActions.action: Assemble official segmented Mölltorp-Gunnarflon plus Gunnarflon-Röåsjön line; keep Klevaberget viewpoint spur separate.
sectionActions.caveat: OSM relation 1173503 covers Röå/Röåsjön, but its Mölltorp start uses the OSM stage-2 boundary about 415 m from the official/KML stage endpoint; do not import raw OSM boundaries without correction.

sectionActions.action: Normalize the four main GPX segments in official order and keep Skarpås shelter spur separate.
sectionActions.caveat: Official/Naturkartan stage 4 has four main segments: Röåsjön-Lunnakulle, Lunnakulle-Skarpås, Skarpås-Mullsjön, Mullsjön-Hjo, plus a short Skarpås shelter spur.

sectionActions.action: Normalize stage 5 by reversing both official Naturkartan GPX segments before assembly and deduplicating the tiny Baståsen backtrack around 58.227546,14.131992.
sectionActions.caveat: Use official display distance 23 km; keep the official GPX assembled length about 21.8 km, OSM 22.267 km and E1 17.7 km partial route as metadata only.

sectionActions.action: Use section-file geometry instructions and Hökensås/Hyltesjön context; recheck section packet before writing normalized geometry.
sectionActions.caveat: unknown/recheck: confirm exact geometry action from section file before implementation.

sectionActions.action: Model stage 7 mainline to Gagnån and keep Fagerhult village/access as connector metadata.
sectionActions.caveat: The continuous mainline handoff is Gagnån around 58.002709,14.104708. Fagerhult village/start area is an access connector, not the mainline continuity point.

sectionActions.action: Keep one official section id and stage number for Etapp 8, with two official child geometry components: Gagnån/Fagerhult-Furusjö and Furusjö-Hotel Mullsjö.
sectionActions.caveat: Use the current official Naturkartan/Smålandsleden split GPX as primary geometry. Reverse the Furusjö-Mullsjö Hotell GPX for planning order and use 57.903080,13.872020 as the official Hotel Mullsjö endpoint unless a maintainer later states otherwise. Retain OSM/E1 endpoint about 57.9042,13.8706 as an alternate trailhead/access cross-check, not as an import blocker.

normalizationActions: Resolve stage 1 variants, stage 2 branches, stages 3-5 segment assembly/reversal, stage 7 mainline/access split and stage 8 two child GPX components plus connectors.
Preserve route variation, branch, access connector and endpoint discrepancy metadata instead of flattening them into one line.
Run visual QA for repaired or reversed geometry before any runtime import.
unknowns: unknown/recheck: exact stage-6 geometry implementation details from its section packet before coding.
unknown/recheck: final normalized geometries may require repeated protected-area overlays if geometry choices change.

sourcePolicy: Import facilities with source-backed coordinates and clear legal/currentness status. Keep Hjoåns dalgång fireplace, Hållsdammsbäcken fireplace/camping, Rödåkra/line 405, natural water, optional businesses and unverified subfacilities pending or suppressed.
Import only managed taps/pumps/service-water points with source-backed coordinates and access caveats. Keep springs and natural water pending unless verified.
importAsCandidateFacilities: Röåsjön shelter can be imported; exact toilet point and co-located fireplace handling need normalization choice.
Röåsjön and Skarpås shelter clusters are importable, but exact Röåsjön toilet coordinate remains pending and co-located fireplace handling needs normalization.
Strong section-file endpoint access, shelter, toilet, parking and transit records after duplicate resolution and currentness review.
modelAsAccessOrMetadata: Rankåsleden, Bergslagsleden, Smålandsleden/Södra Vätterleden/Sjuhäradsleden/E1 and local connectors.
Fagerhult village/start area as access connector for stage 8, not mainline continuity.
Optional businesses and town services unless app scope explicitly includes them.
pendingOrSuppress: Do not import the Hjoåns dalgång firepoint as a usable public fireplace. Keep it suppressed or pending until boundary overlay or an official exception confirms it is legally usable.
Use Baståsen A/B as coordinate-pending transit access evidence; suppress Rödåkra/line 405 as stale unless planner data later confirms a current stop.
Do not import the Vaberget tower claim unless current rebuild evidence is found.
Do not infer drinking water from shelters, lakes, streams or private/bookable facilities.

staticRulePolicy: Apply protected-area rule scoping after geometry.
Run boundary overlays before attaching Tiveden, Granvik/Håketjärnarna, Stora Röå/Röå alsumpskog, Hjoåns dalgång, Hökensås/Hyltan, Gagnån or Mullsjö/Stråken area rules.
Do not attach Tiveden National Park rules section-wide. Apply national-park rules only to route/access geometry proved by boundary overlay to enter the park.
Model Hökensås as naturvårdsområde. Do not call it a national park.
Import Hållsdammsbäcken as shelter/rest with Hökensås caveats, not as Gagnån no-fire/no-tent context.
liveCheckPolicy: Do not hard-code same-day fire-ban state from 2026-04-29 research. Recheck official fire-ban sources before display.
Recheck Västtrafik/JLT/Resrobot planner data immediately before runtime display.
Recheck water currentness before display where water access is user-facing.
Verify shelter maintenance/status before importing overnight-shelter details as user-facing facts.
ruleWarningsToCarry: Natural water should not be imported as potable water unless a managed, source-backed drinking-water facility is identified. Lakes/streams can remain narrative or safety context with boil/filter caveats.
Forestry notifications are currentness/impact data, not durable static trail facts.
Bathing-water quality and algal bloom notices are date-specific.
unknowns: unknown/recheck: exact Skogsstyrelsen polygon-to-final-route-buffer overlay after route normalization and before making public closure/impact claims.

validationChecklist: JSON parse this handoff and every changed research file.
Verify all 8 expected section files exist and are represented in importOrder/geometryPlan.
Confirm stage 1 and stage 2 primary/alternate geometry metadata survives normalization.
Confirm stages 3-5 segment assembly/reversal produces expected endpoints before facility snapping.
Confirm stage 7/8 continuous handoff uses Gagnån and keeps Fagerhult as access connector metadata.
Confirm Etapp 8 stays one official section with two child geometry components.
Run protected-area overlays after final geometry normalization.
Verify Hjoåns dalgång firepoint remains suppressed or pending unless a legal exception is proven.
Verify natural water is not imported as potable water without managed-source evidence.
Recheck transit, fire bans, forestry, business hours, bathing-water status, shelter maintenance and water currentness before runtime publication.

notes: All 8 official stages are now covered.
Stage 8 reroute risk is no longer a blocker for candidate normalization; preserve endpoint discrepancy as a local trailhead/access decision.
Stage 1 and stage 2 still need explicit branch/alternate modeling decisions.
Hjoåns dalgång firepoint should be treated as suppress-or-pending, not importable fireplace.
Natural water should not become potable-water POIs without managed-source evidence.
